chapter: Bebop, band changes and the road
title: He is not a pioneer, just different
summary: Brown calls Hamilton a pioneer, and Hamilton says he is only different.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Which one is going to last longer? One of the things when I look back at your career, I look at the fact that you’ve been -- as you’ve said, you know, you’ve been a pioneer and I actually talked -­
I didn’t say I was a pioneer.
Okay, maybe I used the wrong word but I want to get somebody whose kind of on the cutting edge, somebody who -­
Yeah, well I’ve been different; I mean put it like that.
What would you consider yourself then if I’m using the wrong word?
Well you use any words that you want to, you know.
But you didn’t use the word pioneer?
No, I wouldn’t consider -- you know, I don’t consider myself a pioneer.
You know, we’re all out in left field because we’re drummers.
I might consider myself maybe a little different but, you know, not a pioneer. I’m not a -- you know, well I don’t look at myself as that. But you can call me (unintelligible) if you want.
